payload.rationale: I covered the retro/sample, Zephyr integration and velocity KPI, plus the positioning and zero-effort-capture areas because the shipped async decision widget overlaps the graph’s persistent decision-capture thesis; the anti-Slack and consensus-capture narratives provide the surrounding product frame. I also included the direct-quote style context because Tanya’s statement is the document’s only attributed utterance. The map’s People door was not found and Unplaced was empty; I deliberately left pricing, target-market, next-sprint context-preservation, webhook architecture, and Zephyr rate-limit details out because this short note does not address them.
